## CallerOwnedFile interface

Local write source: an existing file on the executing Mac, written by the caller.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface CallerOwnedFile
```

## Remarks

The caller owns the file. macts reads it and never moves or deletes it. No upload slot is allocated in local mode.
